title: Jim Cramer Says Nvidia GPUs Are ‘More Like Fine Jewelry’ Than Cars. Here Is Why That Matters for NVDA Investors.
excerpt: Jim Cramer compared Nvidia GPUs to fine jewelry on Mad Money, and the analogy carries real financial weight for hundreds of billions of dollars in AI infrast...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • Jim Cramer argues NVDA GPUs hold value like fine jewelry, backed by 75% gross margins and $81.6B in Q1 FY2027 revenue.

  • Nvidia's CUDA software moat anchors a $500B AI financing stack by ensuring installed GPUs retain collateral value years after newer chips ship.

  • Analysts set a $302 consensus target on NVDA against a $223.80 share price, with the August 26 Q2 report the next test of the residual-value thesis.

  • It sounds nuts, but SoFi1 is giving new Active Invest users up to $3,000 in stock for a limited time, and all it takes is a $50 deposit to get started.2 See for yourself (Sponsor)

Jim Cramer devoted a segment of Mad Money on August 12 to a valuation analogy that cuts to the heart of the debate over AI infrastructure financing. "These chips aren't like cars that lose half their value the moment they drop off a lot. They're more like fine jewelry," he said of NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA) GPUs, adding that the Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA) software ecosystem lets "9 year old chips keep their value, even appreciating".

The residual-value question is no longer academic. Wall Street is lining up hundreds of billions of dollars in AI compute financing whose economics depend partly on GPUs retaining meaningful value years after installation. Cramer's jewelry framing maps directly onto that collateral debate.

The Numbers Behind the Jewelry Thesis

Nvidia's most recent quarter provides quantitative backing for the pricing power argument. In Q1 FY2027, reported May 20, 2026, revenue reached $81.615 billion, up 85.23% year over year, with non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.87 against a $1.7738 consensus. Non-GAAP gross margin landed at 75.0%, and management guided Q2 to $91.0 billion in revenue at the same margin, with any China Data Center compute revenue excluded from the outlook. Nvidia details the quarter in its Q1 FY27 8-K press release.

SoFi Active Invest is offering a limited-time promotion. Open an account, fund it with $50 or more, and you could receive up to $3,000 in complimentary stock for Active Invest accounts. See for yourself by clicking here now.

Margins of that scale, sustained across an $81.6 billion quarter, describe a scarce discretionary product with unusual pricing power. The Data Center segment alone generated $75.246 billion, up 92%, with networking revenue tripling to $14.8 billion as InfiniBand, NVLink, and Spectrum-X get pulled through every rack.

Why Residual Value Matters for AI Financing

Cramer's analysis lands as the plumbing of AI infrastructure financing gets built out in public. Reported deal flow includes Nvidia's $500 billion AI compute financing partnership with Goldman Sachs and BlackRock, a new CME Group GPU futures product launching in October, and a fresh $89.9 billion NVDA position opened by JPMorgan Chase. Each structure asks lenders and rating agencies to underwrite the residual value of the underlying chips as collateral.

Jim Cramer 于 8 月 12 日在《Mad Money》中专门讨论了一个估值类比，切入了人工智能基础设施融资争论的核心。 “这些芯片不像汽车那样，一旦跌落很多，价值就会贬值一半。 它们更像是精美的珠宝，”他在谈到 NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）GPU 时说道，并补充说，统一计算设备架构（CUDA）软件生态系统让“9 年前的芯片保持其价值，甚至升值”。

剩余价值问题不再是学术性的。 华尔街正在为人工智能计算融资筹集数千亿美元，其经济效益部分取决于 GPU 在安装多年后能否保留有意义的价值。 克莱默的珠宝框架直接反映了这一附带争论。

珠宝论文背后的数字

英伟达最近一个季度的业绩为定价能力论点提供了定量支持。 2026 年 5 月 20 日公布的 2027 财年第一季度营收达到 816.15 亿美元，同比增长 85.23%，非 GAAP 摊薄后每股收益为 1.87 美元，而市场普遍预期为 1.7738 美元。 非 GAAP 毛利率降至 75.0%，管理层指导第二季度收入达到 910 亿美元，利润率相同，任何中国数据中心计算收入均不包括在展望中。 Nvidia 在其 2027 财年第一季度 8-K 新闻稿中详细介绍了该季度的情况。

如此规模的利润率在 816 亿美元的季度中持续存在，说明这是一种具有非同寻常的定价能力的稀缺可自由支配产品。 仅数据中心部分就创造了 752.46 亿美元，增长了 92%，随着 InfiniBand、NVLink 和 Spectrum-X 进入每个机架，网络收入增加了两倍，达到 148 亿美元。

为什么剩余价值对于人工智能融资很重要

随着人工智能基础设施融资管道的公开建设，克莱默的分析得到了落实。 据报道的交易流程包括英伟达与高盛和贝莱德建立的 5000 亿美元人工智能计算融资合作伙伴关系、10 月份推出的 CME 集团新 GPU 期货产品，以及摩根大通新开设的 899 亿美元 NVDA 头寸。 每种结构都要求贷方和评级机构承保基础芯片的剩余价值作为抵押品。
